viewer: Hindi-speaking viewers scrolling alone at night, phone in bed
hook: रात को कोई एक बार पुकारे... तो जवाब मत देना।
payoff: The mother really calls twice from the kitchen at dawn; the thing that came back to bed in her place called once.
belief_label: invented family rule, framed as a grandmother's saying; not a sourced regional tradition

story.setup: A boy sleeps beside his mother; nani's rule: humans call twice, a once-caller is not human.

rule_or_clue.line: इंसान हमेशा दो बार पुकारता है
जो सिर्फ़ एक बार पुकारे, वो इंसान नहीं होता

rule_or_clue.text: the one who came back said nothing
rule_or_clue.line: माँ चुपचाप बगल में लेट गईं

escalation.text: a once-call from the kitchen in mother's voice
escalation.line: तभी रसोई से माँ की आवाज़ आई

escalation.text: two feet stop in the light under the door, the light dies

false_relief.text: slippers return, mother lies down, he sleeps

twist.text: at dawn the real mother calls twice from the kitchen
twist.line: सुबह रसोई से माँ ने पुकारा
twist.how: Humans call twice: the dawn voice is the real mother, so the thing that returned to bed answered the once-call and is the reason the hook says never answer.

ending_image.text: the blanket beside him turns; a pale face with half of it in shadow

story.scare_pattern: lying-beside-you reveal after a dawn twist
